_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 68 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 166,900 berths as of December 31, 2024'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2024 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 68 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 166,900 berths as of December 31, 2024'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2024 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +94% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.18; conservative 2yr -23%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY15-FY25 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.7%/yr (Q1 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.5%/yr (FY15-FY25 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +52.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY25 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2026-02-06) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (43.4% downside to Bear $197 / +-1.7% upside to Bull $342) | Adj composite 2.98 vs market 3.16: gap -0.18 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +94% above the EPP floor $179 (10x FY26E $17.90) | Conservative 2-yr case: -22.9% total (-11.4%/yr) | At 19.4x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $460 sits above the BULL case; Net Yields +3.1% in Q4 2025, forward net revenue +9.59-10.13% (Q1 2026 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
